revisions: Round 1 of the S-11 regression: the P2-12 support entry matched the customer's own test-registration item, which the customer really performed. The first fix (exclude regist|test) was itself too broad because the correct support item also mentions a test registration; the pattern was changed to match the toggle wording and exclude descriptions that begin with Customer. In all three round-1 runs the analysis owner was correct; only the test pattern was wrong. Disclosed in docs/phase2-s11-report.md.

Final round, run 1: the P2-12 support pattern did not match the wording "turned it on". The analysis owner (support) was correct; only the test pattern was too narrow. Pattern widened to turn(ed) (it) on | switched (it) on | enabled | activated. Disclosed in docs/phase2-final-report.md.
